input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Services clause expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms we remain free to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or to third parties, which meets the preferred position (no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer). Searches for requirements-purchase, sole-supplier, non-compete and competitor-restriction language returned nothing; the only other uses of "exclusive" are a non-exclusive licence grant to us, exclusive jurisdiction, each party's own trademark ownership, and the no-third-party-beneficiary clause, none of which restrict our sourcing freedom. No redline needed.
